description: This file defines the LanguageManager class responsible for managing language files, caching, template loading, and language cache clearing within the SuiteCRM project. It includes functions for loading, caching, refreshing, and clearing language definitions associated with modules, as well as handling language file templates.

classes.name: LanguageManager
classes.description: Manages language files, cache, and templates for SuiteCRM modules, providing methods to load, refresh, and clear language data, as well as handling cache files and external language templates.

methods.name: createLanguageFile
methods.description: Creates or refreshes the language file cache for a specified module, based on templates and current language settings, optionally forcing a refresh.

methods.name: loadTemplateLanguage
methods.description: Loads language templates for a module in reverse order and merges them into a provided array of language strings.

methods.name: addTemplate
methods.description: Adds a language template for a module by including its language file from predefined paths.

methods.name: saveCache
methods.description: Saves the loaded language strings into a cache file and the cache system.

methods.name: clearLanguageCache
methods.description: Clears the language cache for a specific module and language, or all modules if none specified.

methods.name: _clearCache
methods.description: Private helper to delete specific module-language cache file and clear its cache entry.

methods.name: refreshLanguage
methods.description: Loads language files from multiple locations, merges their contents, and caches the combined language strings.

methods.name: loadModuleLanguage
methods.description: Loads a module's language strings from cache or by generating a new cache if needed.

methods.name: getLanguageCacheKey
methods.description: Generates a cache key string based on module and language.

methods.name: removeJSLanguageFiles
methods.description: Deletes cached JavaScript language files and updates the language version.
